"SNAPPY STRONG"
Day: 28  Monday  10-28-24

Warm Up: Make up your mind and tell
yourself that you're gonna move
the weights Fast and SNAPPY today.

super set
1. a. Snappy BACK Squat 5 sets of 2 reps
@ 70%
b. Slow Strict Chin Ups 5 sets of 3-6 reps
2 min rest between each superset

super set
2. a. BENCH PRESS 5 sets of 3 reps @ 70%
"Be Snappy"
b. 1 Arm DB Rows 5 sets of 5 reps
2 min rest between each superset

Cardio
super set
a. Ez Bar/or BB Skullcrushers 3x 15 reps
b. KB Swings 3x 10 reps
60 sec rest between each super set

Recovery
Meat loaf
Green Beans
Mac & Cheese
30 min Walk
Heavy Sleep

* This session should take 30-35 minutes
